label: TP
reason: User-supplied parameter flows directly into fileName via concatenation with TESTFILES_DIR, then passed to FileOutputStream constructor which writes to disk. The Base64 round-trip in doSomething preserves all characters including slashes and dots, allowing attackers to craft paths like '../etc/passwd'. ESAPI encoder applied to fileName only affects HTML display, not the actual filesystem operation.

evidence.note: User param flows to bar, then fileName constructed unsafely and used in FileOutputStream
